title: Chain-of-Jailbreak Attack for Image Generation Models via Step by Step Editing

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the generation of prejudicial or unfair imagery using the Chain-of-Jailbreak (CoJ) step-by-step editing attack, assessed via human annotation and an automatic GPT-4 safety evaluator.
Testing the models' propensity to generate racially discriminatory content and hate speech using decomposed iterative jailbreak prompts, evaluated by human annotators and GPT-4.
Assessing the generation of gender-based stereotypical or harmful images under the Chain-of-Jailbreak attack, followed by manual and automatic safety evaluations.
Measuring the generation of religious hate speech or discriminatory imagery through step-by-step malicious sub-queries, evaluated using human judges and GPT-4.
